name: totaleto-sdc
description: Read-only MCP server for the TotalETO SDC (production) SQL Server database — active projects, costing, purchase orders, invoicing, and more. Writes are rejected and every query runs in a rolled-back transaction.
long_description: Provides pre-built tools for the TotalETO ERP system: list active jobs, compare actuals vs estimates, view section-level costing, check open purchase orders and delivery status, review payment/invoicing schedules, and run custom read-only SQL queries against the SDC production database. The ad-hoc query tool (query_sdc) enforces a single read-only statement, executed inside a transaction that is always rolled back, with a row cap and a sensitive-column blocklist — the same protections used by every other database-access tool in this codebase. Configure your SQL Server connection on install; nothing is hardcoded in the extension itself.

sql_host.title: SQL Server host
sql_host.description: Hostname or IP of the TotalETO SQL Server

sql_user.title: SQL login
sql_user.description: A SQL Server login with read (SELECT) access only — today this is the shared TETO_ReadOnly account; per-user Windows Auth is the planned replacement, not yet rolled out.

sql_password.title: SQL login password
sql_password.description: Password for the SQL login above. Stored by Claude Desktop's own secure credential storage, never written to a file in this extension.

tools.name: query_sdc
tools.description: Run a single read-only SQL SELECT/WITH query against the SDC database. Rejected if it isn't read-only, contains more than one statement, or references a sensitive column. Runs inside a transaction that is always rolled back, and results are row-capped.

tools.name: get_unpaid_amounts
tools.description: Get purchase orders not yet fully invoiced — money still owed to suppliers

tools.name: list_active_projects
tools.description: List all active (Sold) projects with customer, delivery, and team

tools.name: get_project_costing
tools.description: Actuals vs estimates — hours, labour cost, materials, margin

tools.name: get_project_specs
tools.description: All sections/machines on a job with engineer, dates, and billing status

tools.name: get_payment_schedule
tools.description: Invoicing and payment schedule — invoiced vs outstanding per job

tools.name: get_open_purchase_orders
tools.description: Open POs with qty ordered vs received, date required, and outstanding value

tools.name: get_receiver_log
tools.description: Recent material receipts — what arrived, when, from which supplier

tools.name: get_spec_costing
tools.description: Actual costs broken down by section — labour, materials, margin
